note: Real IVF+PQ run, our numpy implementation of IVFADC (k-means 25 iterations coarse, 15 iterations per sub-quantizer; seed fixed). Database = the 138 passages of _real-examples (MiniLM all-MiniLM-L6-v2, raw un-normalised 384-d, squared L2), queries = the 24 questions. The PQ codebooks are trained on the same 138 vectors (no held-out learning set). Demo scale, NOT a benchmark: a toy-size index, k*=16. Produced by build_real.py in this folder.
